name: Born From The Ink
source:
Jump into a dark sepia world of ink known as 'The Cycle' as you discover the world in which birth and re-birth repeats itself in this Bendy-inspired pregnancy VN.

[Edited from [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/born-from-the-ink]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跳進名為「循環」的暗褐色墨水世界，探索這個出生與重生不斷重複的地方。這是一部受《班迪》啟發、以懷孕為主題的視覺小說。

［改寫自[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/born-from-the-ink]itch.io[/url]］
